cadence_basis: A year is how long this app goes before re-reading CDFW's harvest report. It is not a statement about how often CDFW publishes one; CDFW posts these reports as they become available and states no schedule.
firewall: Every number in this file counts a deer or a tag. It renders as a fact with the season and the date CDFW compiled it, and it never moves a match count, a band or an ordering in this app.

deer_harvest.report_year_rule: the newest year CDFW's own Deer Harvest Statistics by Year section links a Deer Harvest Report for, never this app's calendar
deer_harvest.columns_absent_rule: Table 1 publishes no hunter-days column, no hunter count and no days-afield figure. This app therefore shows none, and names the absence here so that nobody later fills it in from memory.
deer_harvest.value_basis: Counts are the digits CDFW printed with the thousands separators removed. Per-cents are the strings CDFW printed, kept whole with their sign, because the department computed them and this app did not.
deer_harvest.group_rule: CDFW issues B-zone, C-zone and D3-5-zone tags for a group of zones, and prints the tag quota and the percent hunter success for those rows as the group's totals. This app prints them as the group's figures, named with the group, and never as this zone's.
deer_harvest.group_label_basis: The group's name is the one CDFW's own note (b) prints. A row belongs to it only where the marker CDFW printed in the cell, the rows sharing that printed quota and that printed success, and the codes the note's own words name all agree.
deer_harvest.notes_join_rule: one sentence per element, joined with a single space, reproduces the note as CDFW printed it
deer_harvest.join_rule: A zone or hunt code is matched to a record in this app only where the two published codes are the same string, character for character. Nothing is folded, padded or expanded: CDFW's own season documents write B-1 where its harvest table writes B1, and whether this app may treat those two spellings as one code is the owner's decision and has not been made. Codes that match nothing are counted, never guessed.
deer_harvest.sentence_template: CDFW reported {total_reported} deer taken in {zone_or_hunt_code} in {report_year} and printed an estimated total of {total_estimated}.
deer_harvest.group_sentence_template: CDFW reported the tag quota and the percent hunter success for {zone_or_hunt_code} as totals for the whole {group_label} group: {tag_quota} tags and {percent_hunter_success}.
deer_harvest.source_disclaimer: This is a count of a past season, compiled by CDFW on the date printed with it. It is not a statement about any other season.
deer_harvest.attribution: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
deer_harvest.no_derived_value_rule: No figure in this file is computed. Nothing is divided, differenced, averaged or compared: every number is a cell CDFW printed.
deer_harvest.as_of_quote: This table provides the reported and estimated deer harvest for 2025 based on hunter license reports received by the Department as of April 13, 2026.
deer_harvest.harvest_scope_quote: The table does not include harvest within Section 554 Landowner Programs or Private Lands Management (PLM) programs.
deer_harvest.table_caption: Table 1 (Pages 1-5) 2025 Statewide Deer Harvest and Hunter Success by Hunt
note_a: (a) Hunter success is total estimated deer kill divided by tags issued.
note_b: (b) B-zone, C-zone, and D3-5-zone tags are issued for use in any of a group of zones.
For these tags, while harvest is specific to zone, figures provided for Quota and Percent Hunter Success are totals for each group of zones.

draw_statistics.expected_publication_basis: CDFW's drawing statistics page states no publication schedule, so this app states no expected date.
draw_statistics.pending_reason: Nobody has opened CDFW's big-game drawing statistics document, so its columns are unpinned and this app publishes no table and no column names for it. A placeholder naming a column that may not exist is how a column nobody read gets implemented from memory later.
